title: Rethinking Evaluation Metrics of Open-Vocabulary Segmentaion
reasoning: The paper discusses human cognition and judgment regarding the appropriateness of evaluation metrics for AI models (specifically segmentation), not topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics in a broader societal or philosophical sense. It focuses on aligning metrics with 'human perceptual intuition' and 'human judgment' within the context of model performance assessment.
